description: Locale configuration module for the Moment.js library specific to the Icelandic (is) locale. It defines how dates and times are formatted, localized relative time expressions, and locale-specific rules.

methods.name: plural(n)
methods.description: Determines whether the given number should be considered plural in Icelandic for localization purposes.

methods.name: translate(number, withoutSuffix, key, isFuture)
methods.description: Returns the correctly localized string for relative time units based on the number, suffix requirements, key, and whether the context is future or past.
